name: Emily Hartson

Analyzed user behavior data to identify growth opportunities
Ran A/B tests on email campaigns to improve open and click-through rates
Collaborated with product team on onboarding funnel improvements
Own SEO strategy and roadmap across multiple product lines
Conduct A/B testing on website and app features to optimize conversion
Build and maintain reporting dashboards in Google Analytics and Looker Studio
Manage paid and organic channel budgets to support growth targets
